sql:
SELECT s.Phone 
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT rtype, sname, dname, cname, AVG(AvgScrRead) as avg_read_score
    FROM satscores
    WHERE dname = 'Fresno Unified'
    GROUP BY rtype, sname, dname, cname
) ss ON s.School = ss.sname AND s.District = ss.dname
ORDER BY ss.avg_read_score ASC
LIMIT 1
